name: Gallatin River (Valley)
blurb: The mellow valley miles below the canyon whitewater. Shallow and quick.

sections.notes: Do not plan this route yet: FWP’s 2017 access guide listed Shedd’s Bridge closed because of an unstable bank. A current usable take-out has not been confirmed.
sections.mapPendingReason: Shedd's Bridge: The official FWP access guide marks this site closed for public safety due to an unstable river bank, and it is absent from the current managed-access inventory. Do not use it as a take-out without current agency confirmation.

timing.note: This route’s intended take-out is unresolved. FWP’s 2017 guide lists Shedd’s Bridge closed because of an unstable bank, and current managed-access GIS does not identify a replacement. Confirm a usable legal take-out before planning this trip.
